description: This file declares the implementation of the XPUHooks class, which provides platform-specific hardware abstraction methods, within the at::xpu::detail namespace. It includes interface inheritance and method declarations related to device management and configuration queries for XPU devices.

classes.name: XPUHooks
classes.description: Provides implementations for the XPU device interface, including methods for initialization, device querying, and configuration management.

methods.name: hasXPU
methods.description: Checks if XPU devices are available.

methods.name: showConfig
methods.description: Returns a string describing the current XPU configuration.

methods.name: getGlobalIdxFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a global index for a specified device.

methods.name: getDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns the default generator for the specified device index.

methods.name: getNewGenerator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new generator for the specified device.

methods.name: getDeviceFromPtr
methods.description: Determines the device associated with a given data pointer.

methods.name: getNumGPUs
methods.description: Returns the number of GPU devices available.

methods.name: getPinnedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Returns the allocator for pinned memory.

methods.name: bool isBuilt() const
methods.description: Indicates whether the implementation is built and available.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if XPU support is available.

methods.name: isPinnedPtr
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is to pinned memory.

methods.name: hasPrimaryContext
methods.description: Checks if the device has a primary context.

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of devices.
